description: Retire the stateless Codecamp chat route and extend the intervention tutor with an ask mode, so all 88 lessons gain memory, lesson grounding, and support telemetry.

sprint.goal: Every Codecamp lesson uses one tutor that remembers the conversation, reads the lesson content, offers graded help, and records the support it gave.

stories.title: One tutor contract with two modes
Every lesson uses the one tutor
Support use is recorded for every lesson
The rate limit works across instances
